_meta.description: Release operations dashboard for sfdc-integrator-service. References metric names emitted by the service — do NOT hard-code threshold values; they live in ops/slo/release-workflow-guardrails.yaml.
_meta.importInstructions: See docs/operations/dashboard-import-guide.md for environment-parameterisation and import steps. Always import into a non-production environment first.
safeguards: No customer identifiers, Salesforce org identifiers, job identifiers, credentials, or raw request payloads in panel queries or annotations.
All label filters must use bounded tag values defined in ReleaseLifecycleMetrics and ReleaseCoexistenceTelemetry.
Panels that depend on metrics not yet emitted are marked status=PENDING.

variables.name: datasource
variables.label: Metrics Datasource
variables.description: Select the Prometheus/Mimir datasource for this environment. Do not hard-code production datasource UIDs.

sections.title: API Acceptance — Request Volume and Latency (SLO-01, SLO-05)

panels.title: Release API Request Rate (per-second)
panels.description: Rate of release API requests segmented by routeVersion (legacy/v2), operationType, and outcome. Source: sfdc.release.api.requests counter.
panels.safetyNote: Do not add jobId, customerId, or correlationId as grouping dimensions — high cardinality.

panels.title: API Acceptance Latency p95 — ms (SLO-01 target: < 2000 ms)
panels.description: p95 acceptance latency for release workflow routes. Alert fires at 2000 ms per SLO-01. Source: http.server.requests.

panels.title: API Acceptance — Rejection Count (Validation Failures)
panels.description: Rate of acceptance-layer validation rejections. Source: sfdc.release.validation.rejections counter.

panels.title: Server-Side Error Rate — % (SLO-05 target: < 1%)
panels.description: Fraction of release workflow requests returning 5xx. Source: http.server.requests outcome=SERVER_ERROR.

sections.title: Release Lifecycle — Outcomes and Active Jobs

panels.title: Acceptance Attempts by Operation and Outcome
panels.description: Release acceptance attempts broken down by operation (QUICK_DEPLOY, DEPLOY, VALIDATE) and outcome (accepted, rejected, dispatched, failed). Source: sfdc.release.acceptance.attempts.

panels.title: Active Workflows (Gauge)
panels.description: Current number of active (accepted but not yet terminal) workflow executions. Source: sfdc.release.active.workflows gauge.

panels.title: Dispatch Failures by Operation and Exception Category
panels.description: Rate of dispatch failures segmented by operation and exception_category (validation, authorization, dispatch, unknown). Source: sfdc.release.dispatch.failures.

panels.title: Execution Duration p95 — ms
panels.description: p95 release command execution duration. Source: sfdc.release.execution.duration timer (bounded by operation and outcome).

panels.title: Cancellation Attempts by Outcome
panels.description: Cancellation attempt rate broken down by outcome (cancelled, failed). Source: sfdc.release.cancellation.attempts.

panels.title: Job Final-Status Coverage — % (SLO-03 target: ≥ 99%)
panels.description: Fraction of accepted jobs reaching a terminal state within 1 hour. Requires durable lifecycle persistence (PostgreSQL).
panels.statusReason: Durable lifecycle persistence not yet implemented. Activate when lifecycle persistence ships.

panels.title: Checkpoint Freshness — max staleness seconds (SLO-04 target: ≤ 60 s)
panels.description: Maximum age of the most recent checkpoint across all active jobs. Alert fires when any active job checkpoint exceeds 60 s.
panels.statusReason: Requires Kafka checkpoint persistence. Use Kafka consumer lag (p-012) as a proxy until persistence is available.

panels.title: Kafka Consumer Lag — Checkpoint Topic (proxy for SLO-04)
panels.description: Kafka consumer lag on the checkpoint progress topic. Growing lag indicates checkpoint events are not being consumed, which increases staleness risk.
panels.safetyNote: Filter by bounded topic name only. Do not add job_id or customer_id dimensions.

panels.title: Status Lookup Latency p95 — ms (SLO-02 target: < 1000 ms)
panels.description: p95 latency for job status query route. Pending status route implementation.
panels.statusReason: Status route not yet implemented. Activate when /api/v2/sfdc/release-jobs/{jobId}/status ships.

query.expr: # PENDING: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{uri=~"/api/v2/sfdc/release-jobs/.*/status", outcome="SUCCESS"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Kafka Connectivity Health
panels.description: Spring Boot health indicator for Kafka connectivity (kafkaConnectivity). Reports UP/DOWN/UNKNOWN. Source: /actuator/health.

panels.title: Hazelcast Cluster Health
panels.description: Spring Boot health indicator for Hazelcast cluster (hazelcastCluster). Reports UP/DOWN/UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Kubernetes Readiness Probe
panels.description: Spring Boot readiness probe status. Reports status from the readiness health group (db, kafkaConnectivity, hazelcastCluster, jobDispatchReadiness).

panels.title: Kubernetes Liveness Probe
panels.description: Spring Boot liveness probe status.

panels.title: Job Dispatch Readiness Health
panels.description: Spring Boot health indicator for job dispatch readiness (jobDispatchReadiness). Reports worker-dispatch or legacy-only mode.

panels.title: JVM Heap Usage — % of Max
panels.description: JVM heap usage as a fraction of maximum heap. Source: jvm.memory.used / jvm.memory.max for heap area.

panels.title: Legacy Route Request Volume
panels.description: Request rate to legacy routes (/quickdeploy, /deploy, /validate) vs v2 routes. Use routeVersion=legacy label from sfdc.release.api.requests.

panels.title: Legacy Contract Conformance Ratio — % (SLO-06 target: ≥ 99.9%)
panels.description: Fraction of legacy route requests returning a response conformant with characterised legacy contracts. Coexistence period only.
panels.statusReason: Automated canary contract testing pipeline not yet wired. Activate when canary sampling is available.

panels.title: V2 Route Request Volume by Operation
panels.description: Request rate to v2 routes segmented by operationType and outcome. Monitors migration traffic shifts.
